classification: static source finding, not dynamic memory qualification
findings: InitialMeshEstimate creates an unreachable raw MeshAdaptive, adopts sub, then returns sub without transferring that hidden owner.
CalculateAreaTriangleMedio adopts the returned sub into another MeshAdaptive, leaving duplicate ownership in the unreachable original owner. Its own raw mesh root also has no visible release.

This audit establishes source structure only; actual estimator execution, leak totals and observer/exception behavior remain unmeasured.
reachability: The visible Generator charge-estimation entry is USE_MPI-conditional; the two historical numeric wrapper methods have no production calls found by source search. This does not establish global dead-code elimination or arbitrary API safety.
scope: Valid exclusive MeshAdaptive insertion is qualified separately. Do not silently remove/rewrite the estimator or classify its formulas/policies as validated.
